title: Degree-zero external tensor comparison
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that $X,Y$ are quasi-compact and have affine diagonals, and that $F,G$ are quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $H^0_k(f,F)$ for module right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] with scalars restricted along $f$, and let $E=\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$ and $\operatorname{externalCup}$ be the specified scalar operations [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. There exists a $k$-linear equivalence $e:H^0_k(f,F)\otimes_k H^0_k(g,G)\to H^0_k(f\circ\operatorname{pr}_1,E)$ such that $e(a\otimes b)=\operatorname{externalCup}(f,g,F,G,0,0,a,b)$ for every $a,b$. No positive-degree vanishing is assumed.

proof.text: Choose a finite affine cover of X. For affine V in Y identify sections of the external coefficients on U_i times V and on pairwise overlaps using the affine product, pullback and tensor section formulas. These identifications commute with restriction, and the sheaf equalizer therefore identifies sections on X times V with Gamma(X,F) tensor G(V). Tensor over a field is exact and commutes with the finite products used by the cover.

Apply the finite-affine-cover equalizer on Y to these natural identifications. Exactness of tensor with Gamma(X,F) identifies the kernel with Gamma(X,F) tensor Gamma(Y,G); no positive-degree acyclicity is used. Empty covers and zero coefficients yield zero on both sides.

Use degree-zero derived-global-sections comparison. The chartwise section formula takes s tensor t to the tensor of their projection pullbacks. The degree-zero Cech/sheaf cup compatibility, together with the scalar cohomology operation comparisons, identifies this with externalCup and gives the recorded formula on pure tensors.
